decision_conditions: <p>The proposed development fails to provide plans of the&nbsp; proposed pavilion and thereby officers are unable to ensure that the pavilion would have an acceptable impact on character and the amenities of neighbouring residential units. As such, the development is contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3.D(1) and D3.D(11) of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS.1B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Plan Local Policies (2013) and the Adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2013).</p>

<p>The proposed loss and removal of the foliage, trees and greenery and contradictory boundary treatment on site is considered out of context and character, resulting in an conflicting appearance within the surrounding setting. As such, the development is detrimental to the established special character of surrounding area as well as the setting of the adjacent listed buildings, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3 and HC1 of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS.1B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 and DM7 of the Development Management Plan Local Policies (2013), the Adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the Little Common Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy (2010).</p>

<p>The applicant has failed to submit a satisfactory Flood Risk Assessment as no drainage strategy has been provided. Thus, the scheme has therefore failed to demonstrate that the proposed development would not exacerbate the risk of flooding within the site or increase the risk and consequences of flooding elsewhere, contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), policies SI12 and SI13 of The London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1 U of Harrow Core Strategy (2012) and policies DM9 and DM10 of the Harrow Development Management Polices Local Plan (2013).</p>

<p>The proposed design, form,&nbsp; proximity to the boundary and limited material palette detail submitted for the proposed replacement dwellinghouse, fails to preserve nor enhance the conservation area and does not retain the positive contribution of the site within the conservation area. As such, the development is detrimental to the established special character of surrounding area as well as the setting of the adjacent listed buildings, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3 and HC1 of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS.1B of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 and DM7 of the Development Management Plan Local Policies (2013), the Adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the Little Common Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy (2010).</p>

<p>The proposed pavilion structure appears to be located partially outside of the Red Boundary line as drawn by the applicant. As the applicant has submitted Certificate A stating they own all land that development would occur on the application form and proposed plans are inaccurate.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The proposed development, fails to provide a current and up to date ecology and biodiversity assessment to establish whether protected species are present on site. As such, the&nbsp; development is contrary to Policy G6 of the London Plan (2021), policy DM20 of the Harrow Development Management policies (2013) and P<span style="font-family: Candara, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">aragraph 99 of the Circular 06/05</span></p>

<p>The proposed development fails to provide a minimum&nbsp; internal floor to ceiling height of 2.5m over 75% of the total floorspace and thereby fails to provide high quality accommodation. As such, the development is contrary to Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DM1 of the Harrow development Management policies (2013).&nbsp;</p>
description: Redevelopment to provide two storey dwelling with habitable roofspace; pavilion in rear garden; landscaping (Demolition of existing dwelling, garage, and outbuilding)
